subject: Television & Streaming
title: Disney+ and the Legacy Strike Back
description: Learn Disney+ and the Legacy Strike Back in one minute.

hook.text: In 2019, Disney launched Disney+ and signed up 10 million subscribers in one day. Netflix finally had a rival.

buildup.text: Disney pulled all its content from Netflix—Marvel, Star Wars, Pixar—and put it on its own platform.

discovery.text: The Mandalorian became a global hit on day one. Baby Yoda dominated the internet before the show even finished.

twist.text: Disney+ launched at $6.99 a month—half the price of Netflix. It was a deliberate loss-leader strategy.

climax.text: Within two years, Disney+ had over 100 million subscribers. The streaming wars were officially on.

punchline.text: Disney proved that owning the content is owning the future.
